signals.title: Puppet Show: "The Brave Woodcutter" (Храбрият дървар)
signals.reason: A classic, lively Bulgarian fairy tale adapted specifically for preschoolers with captivating puppets right in central Plovdiv.
signals.note: Confirmed on pptheatre.com and visitplovdiv.com for October 17, 2026.

signals.title: Puppet Show: "Don't Look For Trouble / An Insect Story" (Не си търси белята)
signals.reason: Playful and educational puppet show following insect adventures, perfectly timed and engaging for a 4-year-old.
signals.note: Confirmed on pptheatre.com and how2plovdiv.com for October 18, 2026.

signals.title: Puppet Show: "The Three Brothers and the Golden Apple" (Тримата братя и златната ябълка)
signals.location: Drama-Puppet Theatre "Konstantin Velichkov" (Milen Penev Chamber Stage), Pazardzhik
signals.reason: Charming folklore puppet show located 35 minutes away in Pazardzhik, easily paired with an afternoon stroll at Island Park.
signals.note: Confirmed on kupibileti.bg and theatrepazardzhik.com for October 17, 2026.

signals.title: Aviation and Air Force Day Special Program
signals.reason: Open-air grounds with dozens of full-scale planes and helicopters to discover just 15 minutes from town, celebrating national aviation day.
signals.note: Confirmed on airmuseum-bg.com and bnr.bg; the special program takes place on Friday, October 16, 2026.

signals.title: Puppet Show: "Monkey Business" (Приключение с маймунка)
signals.reason: A bright comic puppet performance emphasizing friendship and fun with animal characters, ideal for preschool attention spans.
signals.note: Confirmed on pptheatre.com and how2plovdiv.com for October 24, 2026.

signals.title: Puppet Show: "Thumbelina" (Палечка)
signals.reason: Hans Christian Andersen's gentle fairy tale brought to life with imaginative puppetry and whimsical stage craft.
signals.note: Confirmed on pptheatre.com and how2plovdiv.com for October 31, 2026.

signals.title: Puppet Show: "Kosie Bosie" (Косе Босе)
signals.reason: A beloved Bulgarian story about the clever blackbird and the fox, filled with gentle humor and catchy musical moments.
signals.note: Confirmed on pptheatre.com and how2plovdiv.com for November 1, 2026.

signals.title: Damascena Biopark & Rose Gardens
signals.reason: An easy day outing ~80 minutes away featuring safe paved paths, open nature, and free-roaming deer, swans, and ostriches.

signals.title: International Photographic Meetings 2026: 'Memory and Identity'
signals.location: Balabanov House and municipal galleries, Old Town Plovdiv
signals.reason: Curated fine-art photography festival showcasing work by five international photographers; visual art with no language barrier.
signals.note: Confirmed on visitplovdiv.com and plovdiv.bg for October 16–31, 2026.

signals.title: 4th Plovdiv Science Festival
signals.location: Center of Plant Systems Biology and Biotechnology (CPSBB) and Plovdiv Drama Theatre, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Broad festival featuring high-level lectures on genetics, space technology, and resource economics; established that select key sessions at CPSBB are in English.
signals.note: Confirmed on cpsbb.eu and sofiaglobe.com for October 22–25, 2026.

signals.title: DJ KRUSH Live Instrumental Set
signals.location: Malkata Tekila Sofia, Sofia (~70 min drive from Plovdiv)
signals.reason: Legendary Japanese instrumental hip-hop and electronic artist performing live; purely instrumental and non-verbal set within reachable driving distance.
signals.note: Confirmed on bilet.bg and facebook.com for October 22, 2026.

signals.title: Thermal Spa and Roman Ruins in Hisarya
signals.location: Hisarya (~40 min drive north of Plovdiv)
signals.reason: Easy, scenic drive to mineral thermal baths and expansive Roman fortifications, ideal for an effortless adult getaway without language friction.

signals.title: Balkan Skyways bases aircraft at Plovdiv Airport with 8 planned European routes
signals.reason: Major direct flight expansion establishing regular routes from Plovdiv to Germany, Italy, and the Netherlands.
signals.note: Confirmed on bnr.bg and travelradar.bg (announced August 2026 for 2027 launch).

signals.title: Extended night schedule for 7 bus lines and cycling paths added to Google Maps
signals.reason: Key municipal transit upgrades extending lines 1, 9, 21, 29, 37, 44, and 66 to 23:30, alongside digital mapping of city bike paths.
signals.note: Confirmed on marica.bg and municipal announcements on October 14, 2026.

signals.title: Full road closure on Tsar Asen I Street for utility and road reconstruction
signals.location: Tsar Asen I St (between Tsar Asen I St and Avksentiy Veleshki St), Central Plovdiv
signals.reason: Full vehicular closure in the central university district disrupting normal driving and parking patterns.
signals.note: Confirmed on plovdivcentral.org and glasnews.bg that the road reconstruction completed in September 2026.

signals.title: Scheduled water utility shut-off in Izgrev district
signals.location: Landos St and Dzhebel St area, Izgrev District, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Full-day municipal water supply interruption announced for maintenance by ViK Plovdiv.
signals.note: Confirmed on vik.bg official notice published on October 14, 2026.

signals.title: Citizen petition and protests against pedestrianization of Ivan Vazov Street
signals.location: Ivan Vazov Street (Central Square to National Library), Central Plovdiv
signals.reason: Active local resistance and signature campaign against closing this core central transit and parking artery for reconstruction.
signals.note: Confirmed on marica.bg and glasnews.bg on October 14, 2026.
